notebook_section: 19. Is the layer-7 legality enrichment real?

configuration.probe_direction: Layer-7 mine-vs-theirs directions from the lightweight layer-7 board probe.
configuration.gradient_target: Selected legal move legality contrast: selected legal move logit minus mean illegal empty-square move logit.
configuration.bootstrap_procedure: For each sampled position, compute capture-opponent and unrelated-occupied position means; resample positions with replacement and recompute mean difference and mean ratio.
configuration.shuffle_procedure: For each repeat and position, permute the 64 square labels inside the layer-7 mine-vs-theirs sensitivity map, then compare shuffled capture-opponent squares with shuffled unrelated occupied controls.
